entries.en: On the back of a receipt, Virgil drew a map of the footpath to the cabin.
entries.zh: 维吉尔在一张收据的背面画了通往小屋的小径地图。

entries.en: Sumner kept the shop open for ten more minutes so that we could collect the repaired watch.
entries.zh: 萨姆纳让商店多开了十分钟，好让我们取回修好的手表。

entries.en: Have you asked Newell whether the spare key still fits the side door?
entries.zh: 你问过纽厄尔那把备用钥匙是否还能开侧门吗？

entries.en: When the lights went out, Vance guided us down the stairs with a torch.
entries.zh: 灯灭时，万斯用手电筒照着，领我们下楼。

entries.en: Chloe pinned the receipt to the parcel so that the shop could trace the order.
entries.zh: 克洛伊把收据别在包裹上，以便商店查到那笔订单。

entries.en: The last bus had left by the time Thelma reached the village square.
entries.zh: 西尔玛到达村子广场时，末班公共汽车已经开走了。

entries.en: Please leave Otis enough room to turn the wheelchair beside the table.
entries.zh: 请给奥蒂斯留出足够的空间，让他能在桌旁把轮椅转过来。

entries.en: Adele could hear water dripping behind the cupboard, but the floor was still dry.
entries.zh: 阿黛尔能听到橱柜后面有滴水声，但地板仍是干的。

entries.en: “This lid isn’t sealed,” Trish said, pointing to a thin gap along the edge.
entries.zh: “这个盖子没有密封好。”翠西说着，指向边沿的一道细缝。

entries.en: Nathaniel had labelled each cable before taking the old radio apart.
entries.zh: 纳撒尼尔在拆开那台旧收音机之前，已经给每根电缆贴上了标签。

entries.en: We waited while Glenda checked the tickets against the names on her clipboard.
entries.zh: 我们等着，格伦达则将票与她写字夹板上的姓名进行核对。

entries.en: Johan’s sketch showed the cracked hinge in far more detail than the photograph.
entries.zh: 约翰的草图比那张照片更为详细地展示了开裂的铰链。

entries.en: Before the second alarm sounded, Suzy had already packed the first-aid kit.
entries.zh: 第二次警报响起之前，苏西就已把急救包收拾好了。

entries.en: Luca kept one hand on the ladder while I passed him the empty bucket.
entries.zh: 我把空桶递给卢卡时，他一只手一直扶着梯子。

entries.en: The envelope on Lillian’s desk contained photographs, not the missing contract.
entries.zh: 莉莲桌上的信封里装的是照片，不是那份找不到的合同。

entries.en: Marty read the serial number aloud while I wrote it on the repair form.
entries.zh: 马蒂大声读出序列号，我把它记在维修单上。

entries.en: Huntington hesitated at the fork, then chose the path marked with a blue arrow.
entries.zh: 亨廷顿在岔路口犹豫了一下，然后选择了标着蓝色箭头的小路。

entries.en: Only Dwight noticed that the gate was swinging the wrong way.
entries.zh: 只有德怀特注意到，那扇门摆动的方向不对。

entries.en: Percival fitted a new set of strings before returning the borrowed violin.
entries.zh: 珀西瓦尔给借来的小提琴换上一套新琴弦，然后才把琴归还。

entries.en: At closing time, Angelo found a child’s glove beneath the window display.
entries.zh: 打烊时，安吉洛在橱窗陈列品下方发现了一只儿童手套。

entries.en: The note Edmond left on the fridge gave a time but no meeting place.
entries.zh: 埃德蒙留在冰箱上的便条写了时间，却没写见面地点。

entries.en: Xavier pressed a coin into the wet clay to leave a clear circular mark.
entries.zh: 泽维尔把一枚硬币按进湿黏土里，以留下一个清晰的圆形印痕。

entries.en: Giuseppe adjusted the desk lamp until its light fell directly on the torn seam.
entries.zh: 朱塞佩调整了台灯，直到灯光直接照在开裂的接缝上。

entries.en: Phelps set the folded chairs against the wall, leaving a clear route to the exit.
entries.zh: 费尔普斯把折好的椅子靠墙放好，留出一条通往出口的畅通通道。

entries.en: Syd is bringing the projector; the rest of us need only bring our notes.
entries.zh: 悉德会带投影仪；我们其他人只要带自己的笔记就行。

entries.en: Rafael caught the loose pages before the wind carried them into the canal.
entries.zh: 拉斐尔赶在风把散页吹进运河之前，抓住了它们。

entries.en: Cyrus had to move the bookcase a few centimetres to reach the socket.
entries.zh: 赛勒斯得把书柜挪开几厘米，才能够到插座。

entries.en: Hester’s handwriting was easy to recognise, even on the faded postcard.
entries.zh: 即使是在那张褪色的明信片上，海丝特的笔迹也很容易辨认。

entries.en: Flo asked for a sample of the fabric before agreeing to order the curtains.
entries.zh: 在同意订购窗帘之前，弗洛先要了一块布料样品。

entries.en: Tanya had saved the draft under a different name, so the original file was still intact.
entries.zh: 塔尼娅用另一个文件名保存了草稿，因此原文件仍然完好无损。

entries.en: “Take the wider bridge,” Julio advised, tracing the river on the map.
entries.zh: 胡里奥沿着地图上的河流描画着，建议道：“走那座更宽的桥。”

entries.en: Lois arrived with a box of spare buttons and offered to mend the torn coat.
entries.zh: 洛伊斯带着一盒备用纽扣来了，并提出可以修补那件撕破的外套。

entries.en: Declan stopped the recording when he heard a train passing outside.
entries.zh: 德克兰听见外面有火车经过，就停下了录音。

entries.en: Eli held the door open while the delivery driver carried in the crates.
entries.zh: 送货司机把货箱搬进来时，伊莱撑着门，使它一直开着。

entries.en: Sadie found two different departure times printed on the same ticket.
entries.zh: 莎蒂发现，同一张票上印着两个不同的出发时间。

entries.en: Jennie moved the seedlings indoors before the first frost of the season.
entries.zh: 这一季第一次霜冻来临之前，詹妮把幼苗搬进了室内。

entries.en: Emil searched the coat pockets again, this time finding the missing locker key.
entries.zh: 埃米尔又翻了一遍外套口袋，这次找到了那把不见的储物柜钥匙。

entries.en: The frame looked straight until Weldon checked it with a spirit level.
entries.zh: 在韦尔登用水平仪检查之前，那个框架看起来一直是正的。

entries.en: Elsa folded the map along its old creases rather than making a new fold.
entries.zh: 埃尔莎沿着原有折痕折起地图，没有另折一道新折痕。

entries.en: Borg brought the canoe ashore before the storm reached the lake.
entries.zh: 在暴风雨抵达湖面之前，柏格把独木舟弄上了岸。

entries.en: Stu marked the damaged joint with chalk before we dismantled the pipe.
entries.zh: 斯图在我们拆卸管道之前，用粉笔在损坏的接头处做了记号。

entries.en: A message from Dore appeared on my screen just as we were about to leave the café.
entries.zh: 我们正要离开咖啡馆时，我的屏幕上出现了一条来自多尔的消息。

entries.en: Aldo promised to return the ladder on Saturday, not sometime next week.
entries.zh: 奥尔多答应周六归还梯子，而不是下周什么时候再还。

entries.en: Witt could see the ferry from the kitchen window, though the harbour itself was hidden.
entries.zh: 威特从厨房窗户能看见渡轮，尽管港口本身被挡住了。

entries.en: Osborn turned down the music so that we could hear the weather announcement.
entries.zh: 奥斯本把音乐调低，让我们能听到天气通报。

entries.en: After replacing the battery, Willard set the clock five minutes fast.
entries.zh: 换了电池后，威拉德把钟调到比准确时间快五分钟。

entries.en: Timmy refused to leave until the lost dog had been reunited with its owner.
entries.zh: 直到那只走失的狗与主人团聚，蒂米才肯离开。

entries.en: Brice balanced the empty tray on one hand while pulling out a chair.
entries.zh: 布赖斯一边拉开椅子，一边用一只手稳稳托着空托盘。

entries.en: Abe wrote the room number on the back of the visitor’s badge.
entries.zh: 亚伯把房间号写在访客胸牌的背面。

entries.en: Megan took the longer route because the footbridge was closed for repairs.
entries.zh: 由于人行桥封闭维修，梅根走了较远的路线。

entries.en: Piero had practised the opening bars slowly before attempting the piece at full speed.
entries.zh: 皮耶罗先慢慢练习了开头几个小节，然后才尝试按正常速度演奏这首曲子。

entries.en: Johanna left a wide margin beside the recipe for her own notes.
entries.zh: 约翰娜在食谱旁留了宽宽的空白，以便记下自己的笔记。

entries.en: Nadine noticed that the shop’s address had changed, but its telephone number had not.
entries.zh: 纳丁注意到，这家商店的地址变了，电话号码却没变。

entries.en: “The hinge is loose, not broken,” Portia explained as she tightened the screw.
entries.zh: “铰链是松动了，不是坏掉了。”波西亚一边拧紧螺丝一边解释。

entries.en: Octavia waited for the applause to fade before introducing the next musician.
entries.zh: 等掌声减弱后，奥克塔维亚才介绍下一位音乐家。

entries.en: Michell checked the date on the photograph before adding it to the family album.
entries.zh: 米歇尔先查看了照片上的日期，然后才把它放进家庭相册。

entries.en: Justine spotted a missing page when she compared the two copies of the report.
entries.zh: 贾丝廷对照那份报告的两个副本时，发现其中少了一页。

entries.en: Milly kept the empty jar because its lid fitted another container.
entries.zh: 米利留着那个空罐子，因为它的盖子正好适合另一个容器。

entries.en: Aileen had to read the tiny print with a magnifying glass.
entries.zh: 艾琳得借助放大镜才能读清那些小字。

entries.en: Gabrielle drew a red line through the cancelled booking, leaving the replacement untouched.
entries.zh: 加布里埃尔用红线划掉了已取消的预订，却没动替代的那条预订记录。

entries.en: The first shelf was too narrow for Olaf’s collection of old atlases.
entries.zh: 第一层搁板太窄，放不下奥拉夫收藏的旧地图册。

entries.en: Rey held the torch steady while the mechanic examined the underside of the car.
entries.zh: 机械师检查汽车底部时，雷伊一直稳稳地拿着手电筒。

entries.en: Wendell packed the glass jars separately so they would not knock against one another.
entries.zh: 温德尔把玻璃罐分开包装，免得它们彼此碰撞。

entries.en: Lucille had made the beds before the first guests arrived.
entries.zh: 第一批客人到来之前，露西尔已经铺好了床。

entries.en: Ellery paused at the end of the corridor to listen for footsteps.
entries.zh: 埃勒里在走廊尽头停下来，留意有没有脚步声。

entries.en: Lina used a ruler to check that the two photographs were the same width.
entries.zh: 莉娜用尺子检查两张照片是否一样宽。

entries.en: Dara discovered a handwritten note tucked inside the library book.
entries.zh: 达拉发现图书馆的那本书里夹着一张手写便条。

entries.en: Angelina refused to sign until the delivery date had been added to the agreement.
entries.zh: 直到协议中补上交货日期，安吉莉娜才肯签字。

entries.en: Estella had brought an extra blanket for the overnight train journey.
entries.zh: 埃斯特拉为这趟通宵火车旅行多带了一条毯子。

entries.en: Constanze counted the stitches again before cutting the thread.
entries.zh: 康斯坦丝又数了一遍针脚，然后才剪断线。

entries.en: Horatio could smell smoke long before he saw the fire beyond the ridge.
entries.zh: 霍雷肖还没看见山脊那边的火，就早已闻到了烟味。

entries.en: Hyatt left the damaged suitcase by the door and carried only his backpack upstairs.
entries.zh: 海特把坏了的行李箱留在门边，只带着背包上了楼。

entries.en: Priscilla took a photograph of the wiring before disconnecting anything.
entries.zh: 普里西拉在断开任何接线之前，先拍下了电线的连接情况。

entries.en: Enrico kept testing the latch until the door stayed shut without being held.
entries.zh: 恩里科反复试验门闩，直到不用扶着门，门也能一直关着为止。

entries.en: Waldo recognised the tune, but he could not remember where he had heard it.
entries.zh: 沃尔多听出了那支曲子，却记不起在哪里听过。

entries.en: Carly found the receipt in a book she had not opened since the move.
entries.zh: 卡莉在一本搬家后就没再翻过的书里找到了收据。

entries.en: Rocco wiped the rain from his glasses before reading the platform sign.
entries.zh: 罗科先擦掉眼镜上的雨水，然后才看站台标志牌。

entries.en: Winfield divided the remaining rope into three equal lengths.
entries.zh: 温菲尔德把剩下的绳子分成了等长的三段。

entries.en: Helga put a bowl beneath the drip and went to fetch a dry cloth.
entries.zh: 海尔格把碗放在滴水处下方，接着去拿一块干布。

entries.en: Winslow could reach the top shelf only by standing on the wooden step.
entries.zh: 温斯洛只有站在那级木台阶上，才能够到最上层的架子。

entries.en: Trudy had already sorted the keys when the caretaker came to collect them.
entries.zh: 看管员来取钥匙时，特鲁迪已经把它们分类整理好了。

entries.en: Wilma tilted the photograph to avoid the reflection of the lamp.
entries.zh: 威尔玛把照片倾斜了一下，以避开灯光的反射。

entries.en: Hahn checked that the tent pegs were secure before the wind picked up.
entries.zh: 风变大之前，哈恩检查并确认帐篷地钉都很牢固。

entries.en: Rik asked us to wait until the varnish had dried before moving the table.
entries.zh: 里克让我们等清漆干了以后再搬桌子。

entries.en: Wilbur found the missing screw lodged in the sole of his shoe.
entries.zh: 威尔伯发现那颗不见了的螺丝卡在自己的鞋底里。

entries.en: Sasha put the old letters in date order before tying them with a ribbon.
entries.zh: 萨莎把旧信件按日期排好，再用丝带把它们捆起来。

entries.en: Diaz turned the map around so that it matched the direction we were facing.
entries.zh: 迪亚兹把地图转过来，让它与我们面朝的方向一致。

entries.en: Lucius noticed a second signature beneath the first one on the faded contract.
entries.zh: 卢修斯注意到，那份褪色的合同上，第一个签名下面还有第二个签名。

entries.en: Elisha carried the spare wheel while I brought the tools.
entries.zh: 以利沙搬备胎时，我把工具带了过来。

entries.en: Cezanne left a gap between the chairs so the violin case would fit.
entries.zh: 塞尚在椅子之间留了空隙，好放下小提琴盒。

entries.en: Salvatore borrowed a small mirror to inspect the crack behind the pipe.
entries.zh: 塞尔瓦托借了一面小镜子，检查管道后面的裂缝。

entries.en: Elvin wrapped the cracked mug in newspaper before putting it in the box.
entries.zh: 埃尔温先用报纸包好有裂纹的杯子，再把它放进箱子。

entries.en: Raul brought the parcel indoors as soon as he saw the first drops of rain.
entries.zh: 劳尔看见最初几滴雨落下，立刻把包裹拿进了屋。

entries.en: Darrell had copied the floor plan in case the original was lost.
entries.zh: 达雷尔已经复制了一份平面图，以防原件丢失。

entries.en: Abby kept the chair beside her empty because her friend had not arrived yet.
entries.zh: 艾比让身旁的椅子空着，因为她的朋友还没到。

entries.en: Sanford traced the water stain upward to a loose connection in the ceiling.
entries.zh: 桑福德沿着水渍向上查找，找到了天花板上一处松动的接头。
